thread.text: Saw the demo on the postcard. How does the widget come up with the price? We don't want it quoting something stupid.
It only picks a row from a price table built from public Phoenix HVAC pricing, and anything unclear goes to 'we'll confirm within the hour'. Happy to walk you through it on a call.
